# Motion browser runtime

`motion-14.9.0.js` is the unmodified `package/dist/motion.js` from the official npm package `motion@14.9.0`.

Self-hosted and version pinned; no runtime CDN request. Used only by the four workspace presentation hooks. The existing Overview/mascot adapter does not invoke it. The offline preview generator embeds the identical runtime.
